# Aachiammafoods

> Authentic Kerala homemade food brand from Palakkad, Kerala, India, offering traditional pickles, snacks, kondattam, spices, and combo packs prepared using time-honored Agraharam recipes.

Aachiammafoods brings the taste of traditional Kerala homes to customers through handcrafted food products made in small batches. The brand focuses on authentic recipes, quality ingredients, homemade preparation methods, and products rooted in Kerala food culture.

## Product Categories

- [Kerala Pickles](https://aachiammafoods.com/listing?category=pickle): Traditional homemade pickles, including tender mango, garlic, lemon, and bitter gourd pickles
- [Kerala Snacks](https://aachiammafoods.com/listing?category=snacks): Popular Kerala snacks including banana chips, jackfruit chips, and rice murukku
- [Kondattam](https://aachiammafoods.com/listing?category=kondattam): Traditional rice kondattam varieties
- [Kerala Spices & Powders](https://aachiammafoods.com/listing?category=spices-and-powders): Spice powders including sambar powder
- [Combo Packs](https://aachiammafoods.com/listing?category=combos): Curated product bundles
